status_semantics: No field named status. This record freezes the RA extractor and its validity gate before they are run over the population.
position_in_chain: frozen DEC v1 (82bbef16) + DEC gate v1 (99921043) already produced 82525 declination rows. This freeze covers the RA instruments, whose output is paired to those rows strictly by (page, row_index) and never by value.

why_this_instrument_exists.trigger: The sealed WOW v1 epoch tool demonstrated, on its own output, that the B1950 to J2000 declination shift depends on right ascension: same declination -26d45m shifted -12.49 arcmin at RA 14h45m and +16.16 arcmin at RA 23h00m, a spread of 28.65 arcmin across 72 percent of the 40 arcmin sealed B1 window, with a change of sign between 17h and 19h25m.
why_this_instrument_exists.method_rule_recorded: Epoch transforms are coordinate-pair transforms. Declination may never be epoch-transformed independently of the row-bound right ascension unless the sealed transform tool has demonstrated independence over the relevant domain.
why_this_instrument_exists.consequence: Right ascension is mandatory per row. A single offset would move rows into and out of the sealed region incorrectly.

hashes.computed_by: Owner, Get-FileHash on the project copies, 2026-08-18. PowerShell prints uppercase; recorded here in lowercase, same digests.
hashes.line_ending_caveat: Digests are of the bytes on the owner's disk. The repository carries .gitattributes disabling end-of-line conversion, so a clone reproduces the same bytes.

measured_validation_summary.pairing: GEOMETRIC_ROW_Y_ONLY. No value matching, no cadence, no nearest neighbour.
measured_validation_summary.failure_mode: ABSTENTION_AND_REJECTION_NOT_SILENT_ERROR. Both wrong readings were caught by the structural gate.

invalidated_prior_result.reason: non-geometric value-based alignment introduced row-shift ambiguity
invalidated_prior_result.detail: An earlier scoring pass aligned truth to extractor output by matching values, which produced three apparent incorrect readings on one page that were in fact a one-row shift. The error was in the scoring harness, not the extractor.
invalidated_prior_result.rule: This figure is preserved as a discarded method and must never be reused in any report, summary or external communication.
invalidated_prior_result.why_it_is_recorded: The measuring harness had the same hidden assumption the pairing rule forbids. Recording the discarded path is part of the evidence, not an embarrassment to be removed.

environment_manifest.engine_version_difference: The validation figures above were measured under tesseract 5.3.4. The owner's machine runs 5.4.0. Tesseract output can differ between engine versions.

open_precondition.what_is_open: Confirmation that the project copy, run under the owner's tesseract 5.4.0, reproduces the validated per-row values.
open_precondition.why_it_is_open: The archive host was unreachable at freeze time (WinError 10060 timeout against naapo.org), so no page could be retrieved for the check. This matches access gap G-7, which records that archive availability is intermittent.
open_precondition.what_is_already_established: Code identity is fixed by the hashes above. What remains unconfirmed is engine-version behaviour, not code.
open_precondition.how_to_close_it: When the archive responds, run venv_v2\Scripts\python.exe tools\verify_ra_freeze.py. It fetches two pages from the truth set, checks byte integrity against the published SHA1SUM, runs the project file and compares row_y by row_y against the validated values.
open_precondition.binding_rule: The RA population run may proceed after this freeze commit, but any population result carries this open precondition until the check passes. If the check shows different values, that is a finding to investigate and the population output must be re-attributed, not quietly accepted.

immutability_rule.statement: These versions are never modified in place. Any improvement is a NEW version with its own freeze record and its own validation.
immutability_rule.reason: Population results must remain attributable to the exact code that produced them.

known_limits: Nine pages and 91 values is a small validation set.
The gate rejects impossible values only. A wrong reading that happens to be a possible right ascension would pass, and the rate of such cases is not bounded by this measurement.
Page 012-456 yields materially fewer transcriptions because of digit merging in OCR, not layout or localisation. It is preserved as a singular unresolved case and was not optimised for.
Coverage of 73.6 percent means roughly a quarter of rows produce no value and go to review or unreadable. That is the intended behaviour, not a defect, but it sets the size of the manual queue.
commit_intent: research: freeze validated RA extractor and gate before population extraction
